findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: morgan_list_projects · Private data: morgan_profile, morgan_contact · Public sink: morgan_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: morgan_list_projects · Private data: morgan_profile, morgan_contact · Public sink: morgan_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
